conventions.linked: Vendor default. Rows with condition if-user-identified make every row of that SDK linked when the app identifies the user.
conventions.shared: Google Data safety 'shared': true only when the recipient is not acting as the developer's service provider (ads, attribution, data brokers).
conventions.purposes: Apple purpose ids; googlePurposes present only when the Google answer differs from the direct mapping in data-types.md.
conventions.condition: always = collected whenever the SDK is initialized; if-enabled = depends on config/feature; if-user-identified = only after identify/setUser/logIn.
conventions.shipsPrivacyManifest: yes only when the vendor's iOS SDK manifest was seen; no for JS-only packages or verified absence; unknown otherwise.

data.note: Collected only if coordinates leave the device. Accuracy.Lowest/Low or rounding to < 3 decimals before sending → coarse_location / approximate_location.
When only approximate location (iOS reduced accuracy, ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATION only, or coarsened server-side before storage) is sent.
Ongoing background collection is never optional-disclosure. Google Play also requires the background-location permission declaration form and a prominent in-app disclosure.
Collected only if captured photos are uploaded. Barcode/QR scanning processed on device is not collected. Use google `videos` for video uploads.

Collected only if picked media is uploaded (avatars, posts, attachments). The system photo picker (launchImageLibraryAsync) on iOS 14+ / Android 13+ needs no full-library permission; Google Play restricts READ_MEDIA_IMAGES/VIDEO to apps with core broad photo access.
Only if media or metadata leaves the device. Audio files → apple audio_data / google music_files or other_audio_files. EXIF location (ACCESS_MEDIA_LOCATION) uploaded with photos → precise_location.
Collected only if recordings (or transcripts sent to a server) leave the device. Server-side speech-to-text with no retention may qualify as ephemeral (Google) / not collected (Apple).

Apple/Google speech services process audio for you (requiresOnDeviceRecognition avoids it). Declare if audio or transcripts are sent to your server or a third-party STT API; transcripts stored → other_user_content.

Uploading the address book (friend finding, invites) is collection; hashing phone numbers does not make it unlinked. Google Play's User Data policy requires prominent disclosure and consent for contact upload.
Only if event data is read and sent off device. Write-only (adding an event) collects nothing. Apple has no calendar type: use other_user_content (or other_data).
Only if reminders are sent off device.
Step counts / activity sent off device are fitness data (Apple names the Motion and Fitness API). Raw sensor readings used only on device are not collected.
HealthKit/Health Connect data sent off device. Apple 5.1.3 forbids using it for ads/marketing or storing it in iCloud; Google Play requires the Health Connect declaration form.
Workouts, steps, calories.
Nothing collected unless scan results / peripheral ids or readings leave the device. Readings from health devices → health/fitness. BLE scanning without neverForLocation can infer location (Android).

A push token stored on your server (or by Expo/OneSignal/FCM) is a device-level identifier, linked when stored with the user. Google purpose: developer_communications for marketing pushes. Notification permission itself collects nothing.
IDFA/AAID sent off device (usually by ads/attribution SDKs) = Device ID used for tracking. The ATT prompt is required before tracking; label tracking types regardless of the user's answer.

Display file timestamps to the person using the device; not sent off device.

Check whether there is enough disk space to write files, or whether space is low so the app can delete files; behavior must be observable. May skip downloads when space is insufficient.
